column3: “closest relative” renders “kinsman-redeemer”; “has to sell” renders “has sold,” and “the land of Moab” renders “the field of Moab.”
“I thought to inform you” renders “I said I will uncover your ear”; “if not” renders the Hebrew “if he will not redeem.”
“you must also acquire Ruth” follows the read form; the written form reads “I acquire.” “widow” renders “wife.”
NASB adds “the custom” and “of land”; “the manner of attestation” renders “the attestation.”
“I have bought” renders the participle “I am acquiring.”
“widow” renders “wife”; “the court of his birth place” renders “the gate of his place.”
“court” renders “gate”; “achieve wealth” renders “make strength,” and “become famous” renders “proclaim a name.”
“enabled her to conceive” renders “gave her conception.”
“to Perez was born Hezron” renders “Perez fathered Hezron” (also in verses 19–22).
